name: web-dark-ai-writing-tool-ascii-glow-hero
title: Dark AI writing hero with orange glow and ASCII flames
whatItIs: A black landing hero with a floating pill nav, a small 'new update' chip, an enormous white headline 'Write Faster with AI', two buttons (orange and white), and an app window with a glowing orange prompt box. Orange glow and ASCII-character flames rise from the bottom edges.
whatItMeans: Powerful and techy but warm; the orange heat suggests speed and creation.
techniques: Draw texture with letters (ASCII) to make edge glows feel like fire.
Use one hot orange for glow, primary button and logo on pure black.
Center a giant sans headline with generous space.
Give the input box an orange halo so it becomes the hero of the UI.
bestFor: Launch pages with a bold dark aesthetic

vocabulary.definition: A soft coloured light around an element.
A small pill announcing a release.
A navigation bar as a detached rounded pill.
